renderer_guard.no_alarm_case_asserted: test_healthy_rollup_renders_and_raises_no_alarm renders a complete rollup at exit 0; the guard is not a blanket refusal
refuses_when: a required model arm is absent from the rollup
a required model arm scored no task (n <= 0)
a required model arm failed on every task (arm_failures >= n)
